title: Fourth powers of singleton Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\\widehat f(S)=\\mathbb E_x[f(x)\\prod_{j\\in S}x_j]$ denote its Fourier coefficient on the uniform Boolean cube. If $0\\le\\delta\\le 1/1600$ and the total Fourier weight at level $1$, namely $\\sum_{|S|=1}\\widehat f(S)^2$, equals $1-\\delta$, then $1-3202\\delta\\le\\sum_{i=1}^n\\widehat f(\\{i\\})^4$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
